references.text: Caleb son of Jephunneh is first mentioned as one of the spies sent from the tribe of Judah to explore the land of Canaan.
God promises that Caleb will enter the land because of his faithfulness and a different spirit.
Caleb son of Jephunneh is one of only two men from that generation allowed to enter the Promised Land.
Caleb son of Jephunneh survived along with Joshua among the spies who explored the land.
Caleb son of Jephunneh is again confirmed as one of the only survivors from the first generation.
Caleb the Kenizzite, son of Jephunneh, is praised for following the Lord wholeheartedly.
Moses reminds the people that Caleb son of Jephunneh will see the land and inherit what he has walked on.
Caleb son of Jephunneh receives Hebron as his inheritance as a reward for his faithfulness to the Lord.
Caleb son of Jephunneh receives his portion among the descendants of Judah, fulfilling the promise given to him.
